recall.minute: Therac-25, Ariane 5, Knight Capital and the Post Office Horizon scandal show the cost of untested or unauditable software, and ML adds harms of safety, manipulation and addiction, polarisation, job loss, surveillance and discrimination. Responsible AI guides the lifecycle with principles: versioning, provenance and reproducibility, explainability, fairness, safety, security and privacy. To reconstruct a disputed loan decision you need versioned data, code and models, provenance and lineage, and reproducible runs, guarding against library, data, seed, split, preprocessing, hyperparameter, hardware and undocumented changes. Large datasets are versioned by full copies, deltas, offsets, per-record history or pipeline versioning. Transparent and interpretable models such as scorecards can be explained and challenged. Fairness fails through historical bias, tainted labels, skewed samples, limited features, sample-size disparity and proxies, and feedback loops amplify it; documentation, group monitoring and incident plans help. Safety covers robustness, monitoring and alignment; security follows the CIA triad; privacy protects against sensitive inference such as pregnancy from purchases; and regulation runs from the EU's risk-based law to voluntary approaches.
